description: This file defines the MemoryInterface class and related types for managing memory operations, including setting, getting, deleting, and searching vectors, as well as handling events and scope management within a memory system.

classes.name: MemoryInterface
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with memory storage, including CRUD operations, vector search, embedding, event handling, and scope management.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in memory within a specified scope.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from memory, with optional fallback to other scopes.

methods.name: getWithFallback
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a key from multiple scopes in order.

methods.name: setVector
methods.description: Stores a vector embedding associated with a key.

methods.name: deleteVector
methods.description: Deletes a vector associated with a key.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in memory.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys within a scope.

methods.name: embedText
methods.description: Generates an embedding for a text string using AI client.

methods.name: embedAndSet
methods.description: Embeds text and stores the embedding in memory.

methods.name: deleteVectors
methods.description: Deletes multiple vectors by their keys.

methods.name: workflow
methods.description: Creates a scoped memory interface for workflow scope.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Creates a scoped memory interface for session scope.

methods.name: actor
methods.description: Creates a scoped memory interface for actor scope.

methods.name: globalScope
methods.description: Returns a memory interface scoped to global scope.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Registers an event handler for memory change events.
